dogecoin.text: This dogecoin “community” has turned into a twitter/Reddit cult and I refuse to be a part of it. They repeat the same tweets every day, saying the same nonsense... still gonna hold though
Dogecoin makes me see the coward in people. Acting like a dip is the end of the world
With that being said, now would be a perfect time to add more dogecoin.

Y’all can’t tell me some of these dogecoin & Shib coin twitter accounts aren’t a bunch of weird cultists who make false promises about the coins. There are much safer plays you can do in the crypto market I promise! I’m all in on dogecoin but even I don’t know the future of it
